evidence.quote: This implies there likely will be a period after liftoff when the policy rate remains below neutral to support the inflation makeup strategy and maximum employment.
my baseline forecast for inflation over the medium term is for it to remain short of 2 percent over the next few years.
The pace of labor market improvement is decelerating at a time when employment is still far short of its maximum level.
Apart from the course of the virus itself, the most significant downside risk to my outlook would be the failure of additional fiscal support to materialize.
Continued asset purchases will help achieve these outcomes by keeping borrowing costs low for households and businesses along the yield curve.
The Federal Reserve is committed to providing sustained accommodation to achieve a broad-based recovery.

parsed.rationale: The speech strongly emphasizes sustained accommodation under FAIT, expects inflation below 2 percent, highlights decelerating and uneven labor recovery and downside risks, and supports continued asset purchases. It signals a prolonged period at the lower bound and gradual liftoff, a clearly dovish stance.
